structured_data.title: Koushaku Reijou no Rouraku Mission ~Maou to no Seiryaku Kekkon ga, Jinrui Saigo no Kirifuda desu!... tte, Maou ga Onnanoko no Baai wa Dou Sureba Ii no desu ka!?~
structured_data.description: Five demons launched a war against humanity, destroying more than half of its lands. Among them, the Demon King, who has killed more humans than any other, and a duke's daughter enter into a political marriage, bringing the war to a temporary ceasefire. Cecilia, the duke's daughter, sets out to win over and ensnare the Demon King, hoping to prevent the extinction of humanity. However, the Demon King is hiding a major secret...?

community_snippets.title: Wikipedia: A Girl on the Shore
community_snippets.snippet:
[Wikipedia Synopsis] A Girl on the Shore (Japanese: うみべの女の子, Hepburn: Umibe no Onnanoko) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Inio Asano. It is about two junior high school students who enter into a casual sex relationship. The manga was serialized in Ohta Publishing's Manga Erotics F from 2009 to 2013 and is licensed in North America by Vertical.
On August 20, 2021, the series received a film adaptation directed by Atsushi Ueda, starring Ruka Ishikawa and Yuzu Aoki.
